Not Italian_But Italian and Japanese_ Beyond Excellent
Jul 2014 • Solo
I had lunch at this restaurant; I found it only because I happened to be walking in the area. Wainosuke is impressive. The menu is well-balanced with lots of choices. I was beyond impressed with the pasta selections. I ordered the spaghetti crab combination. I thought I was eating pasta in Italy. The tomato sauce was so fascinatingly flavorful combined with crab combination. It awakened my taste buds to a new possibility in 21st century cooking. Their food reminded me of what happens when you cook ordinary food fresh served with a pleasing presentation. I tastefully observed other dishes coming from the kitchen and I am convinced their chef has a great palate and an imagination unmatched anywhere. I really think the local Italian restaurant owners should eat at this restaurant. Please eat at this restaurant--the trip advisor ranking is under-ranked because of the lack of reviews.
